author: HopeTech
name: HopeTech.Common API resource
description: One REST noun across every horizontal layer: a thin controller on ApiControllerBase, the service pair returning Result<T>, request and response contracts, a FluentValidation validator, and an error-code class.

rootNamespace.description: Taken from the host project's RootNamespace.

policy.description: The named policy on the writing actions. Reads inherit the default-deny fallback, which is any authenticated caller; delete the attribute to leave a write there too.

skipValidator.description: Omit the request validator. Only correct when the request carries no rules at all - nothing else references it, so excluding it still compiles.
